items.title: 12.9 Sulfur ki oxidation states ki stability (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.9 with Figure 12.9 and Quick Check 12.4, printed pages 281-282.

blocks.text: Sulfur ki oxidation states ki stability (mazbooti) Frost diagram se samjhai jati hai. Kisi element X ke Frost diagram mein redox couple X(n)/X(0) ke liye nE⁰ ko oxidation state (n) ke muqable plot kiya jata hai (Figure 12.9). Yeh diagram do intehai (extreme) pH qeematon, pH = 0 (acidic) aur pH = 14 (basic), par mukhtalif oxidation states ki nisbati (relative) stability batata hai. Ise standard Gibbs free energy (∆G°) aur oxidation state (n) ka plot bhi samjha ja sakta hai, kyun ke:
Yahan E⁰ standard reduction potential, F Faraday constant aur n redox half reaction mein muntaqil (transfer) hone wale electrons ki tadaad hai.

Jis oxidation state ki nE⁰ qeemat kam ho (yani Gibbs free energy zyada negative ho) woh zyada stable hai; is liye sab se stable state diagram mein sab se neeche hoti hai. Jis couple ki dhalan (slope) zyada positive ho woh achha oxidising agent hai, aur jis ki slope zyada negative ho woh achha reducing agent hai.

blocks.alt: Frost diagram: khari mehwar (axis) par nE° (V) −5 se 2 tak aur pari mehwar par oxidation state (n) −II, 0, II, IV, VI. Kaali nuqta-dar lakeer, acidic solution: H2S(g) taqreeban −0.35, S8 0, SO2(aq) taqreeban 1.8 aur SO4 2− taqreeban 2.25. Neeli nuqta-dar lakeer, basic solution: S2− taqreeban 0.8, S8 0, SO3 2− taqreeban −2.6 aur SO4 2− taqreeban −4.6.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.9: Sulfur ki oxidation states ka Frost diagram (kitab ki Figure 12.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jo nuqta jitna neeche ho woh state utni mustahkam (stable) hai. Basic solution (neeli lakeer) mein SO4 2− sab se neeche (−4.6) hai, is liye wahan +6 sab se mustahkam hai. Acidic solution (kaali lakeer) mein SO4 2− sab se oopar hai, is liye wahan +6 bohat oxidising aur ghair-mustahkam hai, jaisa text kehta hai.
Sulfur ke diagram mein +6 (SO₄²⁻) thermodynamically sab se stable oxidation state hai: intehai basic halaat mein yeh bilkul oxidising nahi, jab ke intehai acidic halaat mein yeh bohat unstable hai.
Diagram se nazar aata hai ke basic mahol mein sulfur ki sab oxidised states element (S₈) se zyada stable hain, lekin acidic halaat mein sab oxidised states element se kam stable hain.

blocks.caption: Frost diagram parhna
rows: −∆G°/F ke barabar; kam qeemat = zyada stable
sab se stable oxidation state (basic mein sulfate, +6)
Kisi species tak zyada positive slope
oxidised states element sulfur se oopar: kam stable
oxidised states element sulfur se neeche: zyada stable

blocks.prompt: pH 0 aur pH 14 par sulfur ki kaun si oxidation state sab se stable hai (exercise Q.2h; MCQ VII, X)?
blocks.explanation: pH 14 par sab se neecha nuqta sulfate (SO₄²⁻, +6) hai, is liye wahi sab se stable hai. pH 0 par sab oxidised states element se oopar hain, is liye acid mein element sulfur (oxidation state 0) sab se stable hai.

blocks.prompt: a) In species mein S ki oxidation state nikalein: i. SO₃ ii. H₂SO₄ iii. SO₄²⁻ iv. S₂O₃²⁻
b) Sulfur ki kaun si oxidation states sab se aam hain? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: +4 aur +6 (Table 12.4). Sulfur oxygen aur fluorine jaise zyada electronegative atoms ke saath 3d orbitals istemal kar ke chaar ya chhe unpaired electrons bana leta hai, aur SO₂, SO₃, H₂SO₄ aur sulfate jaise mazboot compounds banata hai; basic mahol mein +6 (sulfate) sab se stable hai.

blocks.prompt: c) S ki mukhtalif (variable) oxidation states mein d orbital ka kirdar wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation: Sulfur ke teesre shell mein khali 3d orbitals hain. Ek 3p electron 3d mein jaye to chaar unpaired electrons (+4); saath 3s ka ek electron bhi jaye to chhe unpaired electrons (+6). Oxygen ke doosre shell mein d orbitals nahi, is liye oxygen yeh nahi kar sakta (Figure 12.8).

items: Frost diagram: nE⁰ (= −∆G°/F) banam oxidation state, pH 0 aur pH 14 par; sab se neecha nuqta sab se stable.
Positive slope: oxidising agent; negative slope: reducing agent.
Basic mein +6 (SO₄²⁻) sab se stable; acidic mein oxidised states element sulfur se kam stable.
